Join the Market

Vendor Information

Move Mountains brings together dozens of artisan vendors at each event. We are selective, community-focused, and committed to giving every maker a platform that matches the quality of their work. If you make it, grow it, bake it, or create it, there is a place for you here.

What to Expect

What Being a Market Vendor Looks Like

🏫

Consistent Monthly Events

Three events per month across three different neighborhoods. Book one venue or all three. Recurring vendors get priority access for the following month.

👥

Built-In Foot Traffic

Brookfield Residential community partnerships bring local residents directly to the market. These are not passers-by. They are neighbors coming specifically to shop.

🎶

A Real Market Experience

Live music, family activities, and a monthly raffle create an atmosphere where shoppers stay longer and buy more. This is not a swap meet. It is a destination.

How to Apply

Four Steps to Your First Market

01

Submit Your Application

Fill out the vendor application form with your business name, product category, and social media links. Applications reviewed within one week.

02

Approval & Booth Selection

Once approved, you receive a confirmation with available booth sizes and your event date options for the upcoming month.

03

Secure Your Spot

Confirm your booth and remit the booth fee provided in your approval email to hold your space. Spots are first-come, first-served after approval. Recurring vendors receive early access.

04

Set Up and Sell

Arrive 1.5 hours before the market opens. Bring your own tent, tables, and displays. The market handles the rest.

Choose the venue you want to apply for. Each location has its own upcoming dates and setup notes.

Vendor Categories

What We Accept

  • Food & Baked Goods

    Artisan food vendors including bakers, confectioners, specialty food producers, and non-alcoholic beverage makers. All items must be cottage-law compliant or commercially licensed.

  • Jewelry & Accessories

    Handcrafted jewelry of all styles and materials. No imported wholesale jewelry resellers. Every piece must be handmade by the vendor or a direct collaborator.

  • Art, Prints & Photography

    Original artwork, limited-edition prints, photography, and digital art printed by the artist. Custom commissions welcome.

  • Home Decor & Crafts

    Wood crafts, ceramics, candles, macrame, wreaths, and any handmade home goods. Emphasis on craftsmanship over volume.

  • Apparel & Fiber Arts

    Custom clothing, crochet, knit pieces, screen-printed apparel, and textile work. Small-run or one-of-a-kind encouraged.

  • Bath, Body & Wellness

    Handmade soaps, lotions, candles, bath products, and wellness items. All products must meet applicable labeling requirements.

  • Specialty & Other

    Pet products, books, imported wines (with permit), plants, and other artisan categories not listed above. Reviewed case-by-case.

Frequently Asked

Vendor FAQ

Do I need to be an established business to apply?

No. Hobbyists and first-time market vendors are welcome. You do not need a registered business entity to apply, though food vendors may need appropriate permits.

Do I need to bring my own tent and tables?

Yes. Vendors are responsible for their own tent, tables, displays, and supplies. The market does not provide equipment. Standard 10x10 pop-up canopy tents are the most common setup.

Can I share a booth with another vendor?

Booth sharing is allowed with advance approval. Both vendors must be listed on the application and both product lines must meet market standards.

Is electricity available at the booth?

Electricity is not guaranteed at all venues. If you need power, contact us when applying to check availability at your preferred venue location.

What is the cancellation policy?

Cancellations made more than 7 days before the event receive a credit toward a future market. Cancellations within 7 days are non-refundable. Weather cancellations are handled with full credits.

Ready to Bring Your Work to the Market?

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Space is limited each month, so apply early for your preferred date and venue.
